customManagers.description: OPENWRT_TAG pin in the per-device ci/*.env files and the commit it resolves to (OPENWRT_COMMIT, on the next line), tracked against OpenWrt's release tags (github.com mirror of git.openwrt.org)

Tools downloaded by the workflows: a '# renovate: datasource=... depName=...' comment above a line holding version=<tag> sum=<sha256>. With github-release-attachments the sum is the release asset's sha256, which Renovate maps to the new release through its checksums file.

packageRules.description: OpenWrt: auto-PR only for patch releases within the pinned series; a series jump (major/minor, e.g. 25.12 -> 26.x) needs a manual DTS/seed review first, so it waits for approval on the dependency dashboard
Pin container base images by digest (reproducibility: a floating debian:bookworm tag is the weakest link of the supply chain)
Base image major bumps (e.g. debian bookworm -> trixie) change the whole toolchain and need a deliberate, tested switch -- approval only
Build tooling (base-image digests, GitHub Actions) is never urgent: collect it into one PR on the 1st of each month (UTC) instead of one PR per update. OpenWrt bumps are not affected.
Workflow-downloaded tools (actionlint) join the same monthly build-tooling PR.
